rl-rt-read.back: Law, Access, Shape, Face, Water, Cover, Pressure, Wind.

rl-rt-law.back: MU (Management Unit), open season, land status, parks, reserves, No Shooting Areas.

rl-rt-access.back: Roads, gates, Motor vehicle closures, and the 1,700 m rule in Regions 3 and 8.

rl-rt-window.front: Five things to notice from the truck?
rl-rt-window.back: Faces and what grows on them, burns and cutblocks, benches and saddles, green spots of water, where other trucks park.

rl-rt-item22.back: It is unlawful to hunt wildlife from a motor vehicle.

rl-rt-item28.back: No loaded firearm (chamber or attached magazine) in or on a vehicle.

rl-rt-hunt-def.front: Is glassing with a rifle on you hunting?
rl-rt-hunt-def.back: Yes: searching for wildlife while in possession of a firearm counts as hunting.

rl-rt-time.front: Best time to drive and scout?
rl-rt-time.back: Midday. Hunt the edges of the day.

rl-rt-rule.back: The truck is for looking. Your boots are for hunting.
